human_instruction: Do not require rescue; install first and verify

single_operation_rescue_waiver.name: bw_port.authorize_no_rescue
binds: installed vendor ABI and image identity
single_operation_rescue_waiver.scope: Only the serial-rescue prerequisite can be waived. All other write checks are retained.

tests.scope: Offline synthetic NAND only; no hardware was contacted
new_cases: one-operation waiver binds exact identity and package without setting rescue capability
missing, denied or consumed waiver erases nothing
waiver cannot replace container, native preflight, identity or timing checks
slow or mutating authorizer is followed by final time and candidate checks
U-Boot rescue waiver is not consulted for a system update

note: Cancelling rescue preparation does not turn the existing RAM-only payload into a cold-bootable U-Boot image or implement the missing native NAND adapter. No unadapted or RAM-only binary was flashed.
